findings.text: follow-on: _GLOSSARY["budget_source"] still describes only an account-surface or a ledger reading, so the "document" value this change lets a Jev-facing block carry is undocumented where the model reads it.

follow-on: codex profiles are still joined to the provider account window by name prefix (name.startswith("codex"), and profile.startswith("codex") at :904), which is the join the plan followup named as joining on the declared budget_group; it stays unaddressed.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against 7c882130; c8adc9b replaces the two startswith("codex") row tests in outcomes.py with _codex_lane and adds _document_backed_backends plus a document_backed flag to _budget_block in lane_context.py, and aa56ba6f9 adds the landing fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the gate is tests/test_picker_joins_codex_by_lane.py, every tests/test_picker*.py, tests/test_old_names_resolve.py and tests/test_jev_weighs_context.py run -n 6 with a base and a head log each ending EXIT; base.log records 190 passed EXIT=0 and head.log 198 passed EXIT=0, and negative-control.log restores the codex name-prefix test to 3 failed EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that the picker counts codex runs by lane and labels a document-backed reading by its own source; reckon/crew/picker/outcomes.py:83 (_codex_lane) joins a run to codex through ledger.resolve_name and reckon/crew/picker/lane_context.py:127 (_document_backed_backends) labels a published reading, both reached in the landed diff.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it fills baseline_suite (7c882130, base.log, 190 passed, EXIT=0) and after_suite (c8adc9b, head.log, 198 passed, EXIT=0), names the negative_control_log, and its follow_ons already names the prompts.py glossary gap.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared write paths are reckon/crew/picker/outcomes.py, reckon/crew/picker/lane_context.py, tests/test_picker_joins_codex_by_lane.py and the fragment docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/picker-joins-codex-by-lane.html; every path in the two commits is inside that set.

justifications.durability: the negative control reddens test_codex_names_reach_the_codex_lane[gpt-6-astra] and both lookalike cases (negative-control.log:57-59), and tests/test_picker_joins_codex_by_lane.py:181 asserts against an independent window_source input rather than the code's own value.
justifications.evidence: the gate runs the exact files the done-when names and both arms are recorded with logs whose headers carry the revision and outcomes.__file__ (runs/r-20261008T004712736537-picker-joins-codex-by-lane/head.log:4).
justifications.fit: the helpers follow the module's idiom and introduce no name the naming rules forbid (reckon/crew/picker/outcomes.py:83, reckon/crew/picker/lane_context.py:127).
justifications.goal_fidelity: both goal clauses land and are asserted -- the lane join at reckon/crew/picker/outcomes.py:83 and the provenance label at reckon/crew/picker/lane_context.py:167 -- but the plan followup's provider-window prefix join at reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:900 is untouched.
justifications.reuse: _codex_lane routes through the existing ledger.resolve_name owner and _document_backed_backends reads the existing budget.WINDOW_SOURCE_DOCUMENT constant, forking no capability.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path is inside the declared write paths, but docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/picker-joins-codex-by-lane.html carries a measures table where the node's own contract said it writes no evidence prose.
